summary: Retain structured replication failure diagnostics after later successful exchanges

replay.detail: No claim or replay changes; failure observations remain host-local and in memory.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet authority changes.

compatibility.detail: Optional failure metadata carries a stable code, operation phase, elapsed milliseconds, optional HTTP status and sanitized cause. Older observations and failure requests without details remain readable. Success records and carrier-only client notices omit failure fields.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond a normal daemon and replication-worker upgrade.

manual.detail: Use replication-status JSON to inspect retained failure details; no configuration changes are needed.

recovery.detail: Later success still clears current-health last_error but preserves last_failed_exchange until the next failed attempt or daemon restart.
